Groupe Lactalis is a French company specialising in dairy products, including milk powder and nutrition products, cheese, liquid milk, fats and chilled dairy goods. The company, originally known as Societe Laitiere Besnier, was established in 1939 and changed its name to Groupe Lactalis S.A. in 1999. Visible in 150 countries and with on the ground operations in 70 countries (as of 2011), Lactalis has grown to have a global presence and ranks itself the world's leading dairy group. The company employs around 61,000 people and operates a total of 200 industrial plants.  The majority of its operations are in Europe, where it employs almost 40,000 people, however it is active worldwide, with operations in America, Africa and Asia/Oceania.  In September 2014, the Group, through its Parmalat subsidiary, agreed to buy the dairy units of Brazilian food company BRF, and has also agreed to buy units of Brazilian dairy company, LBR-Lacteos (which previously held license to use the Parmalat brand name in Brazil).
The group's branded products include President cheese, Rachel's yoghurt, Roquefort Socieite and Munch Bunch. It also has a long history with Nestle and took over a subsidiary, Claudel Roustang, in 1985. In 2006 Groupe Lactalis and Nestle created a subsidiary, Lactalis Nestle, which deals with Nestle's fresh dairy produce and owns yoghurt brands, Munch Bunch and Ski, in the UK. In addition to its recognisable dairy brands, Groupe Lactalis also provides ingredients for industry, including whey products, lactose and milk powder, to be used in the manufacture of products such as ice-cream, ready meals and confectionery.
Groupe Lactalis also uses palm oil in some of its products. For example, its Lactalis Beurres & Cremes division, produces butters, creams and margarines, some of which contain palm oil, as do the products of the Lactalis Nutrition Sante division. The Lactalis Beurres & Cremes division does not currently measure how much palm oil it uses but it plans to start sourcing RSPO-certified oil palm products in 2015 and to be using 100% RSPO-certified oil palm by 2018 (on own-brand products). Further to this, some of Groupe Lactalis products also contain soya.

Credit Mutuel CIC Group are a banking group headquartered in France serving private and commercial customers. Their services include corporate financing and investments, asset management, individual financing, insurance, and retail banking services, as well as tailored offerings for the agricultural sector. As of 2017, the group's total assets amount to more than 790 billion EUR, with more than 410 billion EUR in loans and advances to customers. Credit Mutuel CIC Group are one of the top lenders to Forest 500 companies, across a broad range of forest risk sectors.

rows.coname: Corporación De Abastecimiento Y Servicios Agrícolas S.A. (CASA)
rows.coprofile: The Corporación De Abastecimiento Y Servicios Agrícolas S.A. (CASA) is a Venezuelan state-owned food company, involved in the purchasing and supply of food and agricultural products. The company is the main supplier of the state-owned retailer MERCAL, involving it in the purchase of a variety of basic foodstuffs, including dry milk, beans, vegetable oils and margarine. It is also one of the top importers of Brazilian beef. CASA also sells own-brand products such as lentils, dry milk and vegetable oils.

Bright Food Group (Bright Food) is a Chinese food industry group involved in agriculture, food processing, and manufacturing, as well as retailing. It is involved in diverse business areas, but its main food businesses include packaged foods, dairy, sugar and vegetables. The group is a major player in China ranking highly in several categories, including dairy and packaged foods. It is also a global player, ranking among the top ten in the world for dairy and the top twenty for packaged foods.

American Century Companies Inc. are an asset management firm headquartered in the US serving private and institutional clients. They provide investment services in a range of disciplines including equity, fixed income and alternative funds. As of 2017, American Century Companies Inc. has over 190 billion USD in assets under management. They are among the top shareholders for Forest 500 companies.

American International Group (AIG) are an international insurance company headquartered in the US that serves commercial and private clients. Their services include life and travel insurance, investment services such as annuities and mutual funds, merger and acquisition insurance, property insurance, liability, financial lines and risk solutions. As of 2017, AIG's total consolidated assets amount to more than 500 billion USD.

Ameriprise Financial are a financial services group headquartered in the US serving private, business and institutional clients. Their services include financial planning, insurance, annuities, lending and investments. As of 2017, the company's total assets under management amount to more than 630 billion USD.

AQR Capital Management LLC is a global asset management firm headquartered in the US serving institutional, corporate, and private clients. Its services cover trusts, private and mutual funds, equities, tax-advantaged, fixed income and ESG investing. AQR Capital Management LLC is among the largest shareholders for Forest 500 companies.

Amul is an Indian dairy company operating throughout India that manufactures products such as milk, butter, cheese, ice-cream, and other food and beverages. The company also produces its own cattle feed. These products involve significant amounts of palm oil and soya, as well as paper for packaging. It is one of the largest companies in India by market share for packaged food, dairy, and ice-cream and frozen desserts. Additionally, it is among the top five Indian companies by market share for oils and fats.

Grupo Jari, founded in 1994, is a prominent company in the forestry, paper and packaging sectors in Brazil. It claims to be one of the largest producers of corrugated cardboard packaging in Brazil and is responsible for 3% of eucalyptus pulp on the international market.
In 2010, the Group reported that it was responsible for 1.3 million hectares of forest in the Brazilian Amazon, including 545,000 hectares of native forest and 120,000 hectares authorised for plantations. The Group's native forests are located in the Vale do Jari, on the border of the states of ParÃ¡ and AmapÃ¡. According to Brazil's National Confederation of Industry (CNI), Grupo Jari is responsible for the largest area of natural forests under sustainable management in the Brazilian Amazon and is one of the country's principal producers of sawnwood. Grupo Jari produces sawn timber for the furniture and construction industries. Although it represented just 0.3% of total sawnwood production from the Brazilian Amazon in 2010, this is significant given that Brazil is the top producer of tropical sawnwood globally, responsible for 37.54% of total production from all ITTO producer countries (2007-2012). 
Jari was initially made up of three companies: Jari Celulose, Papel e Embalagens S.A.; Jari Florestal; and Ouro Verde Amazonia. In 2012, however, Jari Celulose, Papel e Embalagens S.A. and US-based firm, International Paper, formed a joint corrugated packaging venture: Orsa International Paper Embalagens S.A. Having originally owned 75% of the joint venture, International Paper acquired the remainder in 2014 and is therefore is now in charge of Jari Celulose's packaging assets. Groupo Jari also partners with a number of companies manufacturing construction materials, such as wooden decks and flooring, for overseas retailers.
Camera Agroalimentos S.A. is a prominent Brazilian agribusiness. The company produce, process and trade in soybean and manufacture biodiesel.

Bank of China Ltd. are a global financial services provider headquartered in China serving both corporate and private clients. Their corporate services include corporate financing, trade services, cash management, savings, and currency services while their personal banking covers savings, loans, wealth management, and foreign exchange. Bank of China Ltd.'s wholly owned subsidiaries also provide insurance, aircraft leasing, asset management and investment services. As of 2017, Bank of China Ltd.'s total assets amount to more than 19 trillion RMB, with over 10 trillion RMB in loans. They are among the top lenders to Forest 500 companies with loans across a broad range of forest risk sectors.

Headquartered in the US, Berkshire Hathaway Inc. are a holding company whose main businesses operate in the insurance, freight rail transportation, and energy and utility sectors.  As of 2017, Berkshire Hathaway Inc.'s total consolidated assets amount to over 680 billion USD.

Capital Group Co. Inc. are an asset management company headquartered in the US serving institutional, corporate, intermediary and private clients. Their services include investment, wealth and asset management, trust and advisory services, and equity, fixed income and multi-asset investment funds and strategies. As of 2017, Capital Group Co. Inc.'s total assets under management amount to more than 1.4 trillion USD. They are among the top shareholders for Forest 500 companies.

Charles Schwab Corp. are a financial services company headquartered in the US serving institutional, corporate, intermediary and private clients. Their services include wealth and asset management, banking, custodial, financial advisory, retirement plan services, retail, securities, and corporate brokerage, and support services. As of 2017, Charles Schwab Corp.'s total assets amount to over 230 billion USD and their total client assets stand at over 3.1 trillion USD. They are among the top shareholders for Forest 500 companies.
Cencoprod Ltda. is an alliance between cooperatives in Paraguay’s Chaco processing both meat and leather products.

OJSC Magnit is a Russian holding company, operating in the Russian food retail sector. Magnit is an Open Joint Stock Company (OJSC) and is among Russia's largest retailers. The company operates four types of stores: Magnit convenience stores, of which it runs almost 7700; Magnit hypermarkets, of which it has 170; Magnit Family stores, of which is operates over 60; and Magnit cosmetics stores, of which it runs 816.
The company began in household chemical wholesale in the mid-1990s, and has since expanded into the retail market. Today it ranks as the top retailer in the Russian market in terms of its sales and its presence across Russia, and employs around 230,000 people. Magnit produces around 700 private label products for its stores, amounting to 13% of total sales in 2012. Included in Magnit's ranges of goods are a variety of meat products, including a range of unbranded and branded private label frozen and chilled meat products, including beef.
Between 2007 and 2012, Russia imported over 23% of Brazil's total beef exports, which accounted for around 40% of Russia's total beef and veal import market (in 2010); therefore, as a leading retailer and stockist of meat products in Russia, Magnit is at significant risk of supplying beef products linked to tropical deforestation. In 2009 Magnit began to import goods from abroad run by its subsidiary company Tander. By the end of 2013, company's import accounted for 10% of its turnover. During the first six months of 2014, Tander was in top 10 Russia's importers with total volume of import in amount of $830.58 million.
Grupo Bom Retiro is a Brazilian company operating in the business of industrialising salted hides and finished leather.

East Hope Group was founded in 1982 and is based in Shanghai, China. In 2014, it was among the ten largest producers of animal feed globally, manufacturing a range of pig, poultry, cattle, and aquaculture feed. In the agricultural division of the company, the group operates seven brands, including 'East Hope' and numerous subsidiaries in China, Vietnam, Singapore, Indonesia and Cambodia. In total, the group operates a total around 100 mills and produces over 8 million metric tons of feed. On top of its activities in agriculture, the group is active in the heavy industry and chemical industry sectors, with operations including in electricity, mining, non-ferrous metals, petrochemicals, biochemistry and construction materials.
East Hope Group is the largest of what was originally the Hope Group of companies. Following its extensive growth, the Hope Group, established by the Liu brothers, was divided into four companies: East Hope, West Hope, New Hope and Continental Hope.

rows.coname: Sociedad Cooperativa Colonizadora Chortitzer Komitee Ltda
rows.coprofile: Cooperativa Chortitzer Ltda. is a cooperative operating in the production, processing and sale of cattle products.  Sociedad Cooperativa Colonizadora Chortitzer Komitee Ltda is selected as a powerbroker for beef.
Evershining Ingredient is an animal feed manufacturer based in Thailand.

Eaton Vance Management are an asset management company headquartered in the US serving private, corporate, intermediary and institutional clients. Their services cover wealth management, retirement and advisory services, and investments across mutual, global equity, fixed income, multi-asset, alternative investment funds. As of 2017, Eaton Vance Management's total assets under management amount to more than 400 billion USD. They are among the top shareholders for Forest 500 companies.

Employees Provident Fund are a government owned pension fund headquartered in Malaysia that serves private and public sector employees. As of 2017, Employees Provident Fund's total assets under management amount to over 740 billion RM with over 70 billion RM worth of loans, advances and financing. Employees Provident Fund are among the top shareholders for Forest 500 companies.

rows.coname: Farm Credit Services Commercial Finance Group
rows.coprofile: The Farm Credit Services (FCS) Commercial Finance Group are a joint venture of multiple US based Farm Credit Associations that have pooled financial capital and resources to support agribusiness and rural infrastructure projects. Their services are focused on corporate financing, including term loans, real estate loans and lines of credit. The group has over 2 billion USD in combined capital and they have provided several billion dollars in financing to companies since their inception. FSC Commercial Finance Group are one of the top lenders to Forest 500 companies, predominantly in the packaged food and agricultural commodity sectors.

3G Capital Partners Ltd. is a private equity investment company headquartered in the US that specializes in pooled investments and investment buyouts. 3G Capital Partners Ltd. is among the largest shareholders for Forest 500 companies.

Fidelity Investments are a financial services company headquartered in the US offering investment and asset management services for individuals and institutions. Their services include annuities, workplace pensions, wealth management and institutional investment products. As of 2017, Fidelity has 2.4 trillion USD in global assets under management and 6.5 trillion USD of customer assets in total. Fidelity Investments are one of the top shareholders in Forest 500 companies, including cosmetics, food, construction and agriculture.

Fifth Third Bancorp are a US-based financial services company serving private and corporate clients. Their services include capital markets, corporate finance, investment solutions, retirement planning, insurance, wealth management and retail banking. As of 2017, the company's total assets amount to more than 140 billion USD with loans and leases of more than 90 billion USD. Fifth Third Bancorp are among the top lenders to Forest 500 companies, particularly in the food and agricultural sectors.

Franklin Resources are an investment management firm headquartered in the US that serves private and institutional clients. Their services cover equity, fixed-income, multi-asset and alternative funds. As of 2017, Franklin Resources' total assets under management amount to more than 700 billion USD. They are among the top bondholders and shareholders for Forest 500 companies, across a broad range of forest risk sectors.

Geode Capital Management are an investment management firm headquartered in the US that serves retail and institutional clients. Their services cover investments across equity, commodity, global, custom and multi-asset classes. As of 2017, Geode Capital Management's total assets under management amount to over 300 billion USD. They are among the top shareholders for Forest 500 companies.

The Japan Agricultural Cooperatives Group (JA Group) is an agricultural cooperative, established to support its members by selling their products rather than each of its members selling products independently. On top of this, JA Group provides its members with production materials and agrochemicals. The group is a politically powerful organisation and is comprised of almost ten million regular and associate members. 
The JA Group is made up of several constituent parts, including ZEN-NOH, which is the National Federation of Agricultural Cooperative Associations. ZEN-NOH manages the business and distribution operations of the JA Group and is responsible for the marketing and supply business side of the group. Of particular relevance, are ZEN-NOH's operations in the animal feed sector. Of the total 24 to 25 million tonnes of compound feed used per year in Japan, ZEN-NOH handles around 30%, making ZEN-NOH Japan's largest compound feed producer and one of the top ten in the world. Through its subsidiaries, ZEN-NOH imports large volumes of soya from overseas producers including Brazil, India and China for use in compound animal feeds.
Also of relevance, is the group's Daily Necessities business unit, through which ZEN-NOH and JA run around 800 A-Coop supermarkets. The stores sell clothing, food products and consumer durables, and prioritise goods produced by members and sell A-Coop branded goods. Currently there are around 1,300 A-Coop branded goods, which include packaged food and clothing.

ICICI is based in India and provides banking products and financial services to both corporate and retail customers. The bank specialises in the areas of personal and investment banking, life and general insurance, and asset management.
F.R.I.A.R. S.A. are an Argentine beef manufacturer.
Rioverde OOO, located in Russia, undertake the wholesale distribution of groceries and related products, including beef.
Frigorifico Gorina S.A. is a prominent Argentine meat processor supplying to the international market.
Loyaline Limited is a private company that trades large volumes of Indonesian palm oil.
Kumpulan Wang Persaraan was founded in 2007 and manages the pension fund for Malaysia's public employees.

Lazard Ltd. is an international financial advice and asset management firm headquartered in Bermuda serving private, corporate, sovereign entity, government, partnership and institutional clients. It is among the top shareholders for Forest 500 companies.
Lincoln National Corporation is a financial services group with subsidiaries in insurance and investment management. The group is among the largest bond holders in Forest 500 companies.

MetLife are a financial services provider headquartered in the US with offerings for private and commercial clients. Their services include various forms of insurance, corporate retirement and benefit solutions, and institutional investments. As of 2017, MetLife's total assets amount to more than 925 billion USD, with more than 360 billion USD in various forms of securities. MetLife are one of the top bondholders for Forest 500 companies, across a broad range of forest risk sectors.

Bank of the Philippine Islands is a commercial bank and operates through consumer banking, corporate banking and investment banking segments. The bank offers services such as insurance, asset management and consumer banking and lending.
Evershining Ingredient is an animal feed manufacturer based in Thailand. Soy is a key component of animal feed.   Evershining Ingredient is selected as a powerbroker for soy and paper packaging.

Euro America is a Brazilian company operating in import and export services. The company engages in shipping and international transport, with a speciality in leather goods.  EURO AMERICA is selected as a powerbroker for leather.

Foshan Saturday Shoes is a Chinese manufacturer and retailer of footwear. The company owns several brands, including ST&SAT, FBL and SAFIYA and acts as the agent in China for other brands, such as Stonefly. The company is one of the largest shoe store companies in China.  Foshan Saturday Shoes Co. Ltd.  is selected as a powerbroker for leather and paper packaging.

East Hope Group is a Chinese company that primarily produces animal feed but also produces chemicals and other products. The group operates 111 animal feed subsidiaries in China, Singapore, Vietnam, Indonesia, Cambodia, and other countries. Its animal feed products include feed for cattle, poultry, pigs, and aquaculture. Important brands include “East Hope”, “Golden Bean” and “Red Gate”. It is one of the largest producers of animal feed in the world.  East Hope Group is selected as a powerbroker for palm oil, soy and paper packaging and is also assessed for its exposure to timber.
Donto is an Argentine leather manufacturer which produces leather for use by furniture manufacturers.  Donto is selected as a powerbroker for leather.
Frigorifico Gorina S.A. is a prominent Argentine meat processor supplying to the international market.  Frigorifico Gorina Sociedad Anonima Industrial Y Comex is selected as a powerbroker for beef.

Future Group is an Indian conglomerate with operations in the retail, fashion, food, home and personal care and home fashion sectors.  Future Group is selected as a powerbroker for palm oil, soy, beef and paper packaging and is also assessed for its exposure to leather.
Directa Line is a Brazilian logistics company operating in international trade.  DIRECTA LINE LOGISTICA is selected as a powerbroker for leather.

Darmex Agro is an Indonesian producer and processer of palm oil. It claims to be one of the largest such companies in Indonesia. The group operates plantations on Indonesian Borneo and Sumatra.  Darmex Agro is selected as a powerbroker for palm oil.

Dalian Huafeng Furniture is a Chinese company specialising in furniture manufacturing, producing solid wood furniture. It is one of the largest wooden furniture manufacturers in China with a significant domestic market share and also exports to the US, Southeast Asia and European countries.  Dalian Huafeng Furniture Co. Ltd. is selected as a powerbroker for timber and paper packaging.

rows.coprofile: The Corporación de Abastecimientos y Servicios Agrícolas (CASA) is a Venezuelan state-owned food company, involved in the purchasing and supply of food and agricultural products. It is one of the top importers of Brazilian beef. CASA also sells own-brand products such as lentils, dry milk and vegetable oils.  CorporaciÃ³n De Abastecimiento Y Servicios AgrÃ­colas S.A. (CASA) is selected as a powerbroker for beef and is also assessed for its exposure to palm oil and soy.
Coop Freight Logistics Ltd is a large Taiwanese trading company.  COOP FREIGHT LOGISTICS LTD is selected as a powerbroker for leather.

Groupe Lactalis is a French company that specialises in dairy products. The company have more than 230 industrial plants spread over 40 countries. Under a range of different brands the company mainly produce cheese, milk, cream, butter, and milk powder. Lactalis claim to be the largest dairy group in the world, and the number one cheese group in Europe. Groupe Lactalis use palm oil in its products and is exposed to soy as a component of animal feed for dairy products.  Groupe Lactalis is selected as a powerbroker for palm oil, soy and paper packaging.
Compania Paraguaya de Granos SA are one of the top exporters of soybeans in Latin America.

rows.coprofile: Compañia Industrial Aceitera Coto Cincuenta y Cuatro S.A operates as both a palm oil mill and crude oil trading company in Costa Rica.  CompaÃ±ia Industrial Aceitera Coto Cincuenta y Cuatro S.A is selected as a powerbroker for palm oil.

Belle International Holdings is a Chinese business primarily involved in the manufacturing and retail of footwear and apparel. It owns several brands including Belle, Staccato, and Tata, and manufactures shoes for other brands including Clarks and Mephisto. Its apparel business is focussed on retail distribution, including with brands such as Nike, Adidas, and Puma. It is one of the largest global footwear manufacturers and is also one of the largest Chinese shoe stores.
Grupo Bom Retiro is a Brazilian processor of salted hides and finished leather.  Grupo Bom Retiro is selected as a powerbroker for leather.

Grupo Jari, founded in 1994, is a prominent company in the forestry, paper and packaging sectors in Brazil. It claims to be one of the largest producers of corrugated cardboard packaging in Brazil and is responsible for 3% of eucalyptus pulp on the international market.  Grupo Jari is selected as a powerbroker for timber.

China State Construction Engineering Corp is a state-owned corporation involved in housing and infrastructure construction, as well as real estate development and international contracting. It is one of China’s largest construction and real estate companies, but also operates globally in 20 countries and is one of the leading construction companies globally. Housing construction exposes the company to timber.  China State Construction Engineering Corp. is selected as a powerbroker for timber and paper packaging.
Catter Meat S.A. is an Argentinean producer of meat products.  CATTER MEAT SA is selected as a powerbroker for beef.

rows.coname: Guangdong Wens Foodstuff Group Co., Ltd
rows.coprofile: Guangdong Wen’s Group is a Chinese livestock and poultry breeding company. The company operates within several industries, mainly chicken, pig, sheep, pigeon, goose, and duck. The group also produce packaged food and agriculture equipment. Soy is a commonly used ingredient in animal feed.   Guangdong Wens Foodstuff Group Co., Ltd is selected as a powerbroker for palm oil, soy and paper packaging.

Guangzhou Highest Industrial is a China-based trader and processor of timber that is also involved in some financial business. African wood is an important raw material, and one of the company’s subsidiaries is solely for procuring African wood. The company produces a variety of processed woods from different locations and also produces plywood.  Guangzhou Highest Industrial Co. Ltd. is selected as a powerbroker for timber and paper packaging.

Camera Agroalimentos S.A. is a prominent Brazilian agribusiness. The company produces, processes and trades in soybean and manufactures biodiesel.  Camera Agroalimentos S.A. is selected as a powerbroker for soy.

Haid Group is a Chinese manufacturing company operating in the business of animal feed. Soy and palm oil are often components of animal feed.  Haid Group is selected as a powerbroker for palm oil, soy and paper packaging.

Bright Food Group is a Chinese food industry group involved in agriculture, food processing, and manufacturing, as well as retailing. It is involved in diverse business areas, but its main food businesses include packaged foods, dairy, sugar and vegetables. The group is a major player in China and globally including in dairy and packaged foods.   Bright Food (Group) Co. Ltd. is selected as a powerbroker for palm oil, soy and paper packaging.

rows.coname: Nanyang Hoo’s Furniture Manufacturing Co. Ltd.
rows.coprofile: Nanyang HooÃ¢â‚¬â„¢s Furniture Manufacturing is a manufacturer of furniture in China producing high quality solid wood products. Its furniture and furniture accessories are used in households, offices, and hotels, with over 200 products on offer. Nanyang HooÃ¢â‚¬â„¢s Furniture is one of the largest furniture manufacturers in China. Some of its ranges use African woods such as ebony and rosewood, with one range being sourced from Gabon.

Bricapar S.A. is Paraguay’s largest exporter of charcoal. The company manufactures forest industrial residue and exports to the US and Northern Europe.  Bricapar S.A. is selected as a powerbroker for timber and is also assessed for its exposure to pulp & paper.

BF Logistics are a logistics company specializing in International freight and exports, based in Brazil. They are assessed for their exposure to leather due to the large volume of leather they export from Brazil, and are also assessed for pulp and paper through their use of cardboard boxes throughout the transport network.
Bianchini S.A. is a Brazilian industrial company dealing in the extraction of vegetable oils and the processing and export of soy.   Bianchini is selected as a powerbroker for soy.

Bhartiya International Ltd. is an Indian holding company with business segments in leather and textile products. The company manufactures and exports leather garments globally.  Bhartiya International Ltd is selected as a powerbroker for leather and is also assessed for its exposure to timber, pulp & paper and paper packaging.

Belle International Holdings is a Chinese business primarily involved in the manufacturing and retail of footwear and apparel. It owns several brands including Belle, Staccato, and Tata, and manufactures shoes for other brands including Clarks and Mephisto. It is one of the largest global footwear manufacturers and is also one of the largest Chinese shoe retailers.  Belle International Holdings Ltd. is selected as a powerbroker for leather and paper packaging.

The Beidahuang Group is China’s largest agricultural and agribusiness group. It is involved in a variety of business, such as pharmaceuticals, food products, oils, and agriculture. The group claims to be the largest processor of soy in China. This is turned into meal and oil for food products and edible oils. It is also a leading importer of Brazilian soy.  Beidahuang Group is selected as a powerbroker for soy.

Behshahr Industrial Development Corp. is a company based in Iran involved in the production of edible oils and fats. The company has a major market share in Iran’s edible oil market, and is among the largest companies in the worldwide edible oils market.  Behshahr Industrial Development Corp. is selected as a powerbroker for palm oil, soy and paper packaging.
Shuangbaotai Group (Twins Group), based in China, research and manufacture animal feed products. They are also a top 500 Chinese manufacturing company.

rows.coname: Sociedad Cooperativa Colonizadora Chortitzer Komitee Ltda
rows.coprofile: Sociedad Cooperativa Colonizadora Chortitzer Komitee Ltda is a Paraguayan company that produces, processes and sells cattle products. Their livestock plantation, FrigoChorti, is the only slaughterhouse in the Central Chaco and slaughters more than 200,000 cattle per year. The company has been selected as a powerbroker for beef.

Ashley Furniture is an American manufacturer and retailer of home furnishings and furniture with retail partners in 123 countries. The company claims to be the largest manufacturer of furniture globally, it is one of the largest home furnishing companies both in the US and the world.  Ashley Furniture Industries Inc.  is selected as a powerbroker for leather, timber and paper packaging.
Arre Beef S.A. are an Argentine meat processor trading globally in beef and beef-by-products.  Arre Beef S.A. is selected as a powerbroker for beef.

Industrias Frigorificas Recreo S.A.I.C. is an Argentinean company, headquartered in the city of Recreo in Catamarca region. They are assessed for beef as both a processor and manufacturer, owning slaughterhouses supplying both the domestic and international markets.

rows.coname: Irmãos Gonçalves Comercio e Industria Ltda
rows.coprofile: Irmãos Gonçalves Comercio e Industria Ltda is based in Brazil and operates in the meat packaging and slaughter house industry.  Irmaos Goncalves Comercio E Industria Ltda. is selected as a powerbroker for beef.

Aokang is a leather company, manufacturing and retailing shoes as well as other leather products. It owns four brands: Aokang, Kanglong, Redess and MeiRie, as well as an Italian brand, VALLEVERDE. It is one of the largest footwear manufactures in China and is also among the largest retailers of footwear in China and Hong Kong.  Aokang Group Co. Ltd. is selected as a powerbroker for leather and paper packaging.

Amul is an Indian dairy company operating throughout India that manufactures products such as milk, butter, cheese, ice-cream, and other food and beverages. The company also produces its own cattle feed. These products involve significant amounts of palm oil and soy, as well as paper for packaging. It is one of the largest companies in India by market share for packaged food, dairy, and ice-cream and frozen desserts as well as oils and fats.  Amul is selected as a powerbroker for palm oil, soy and paper packaging.
Catter Meat S.A. are an Argentinean producer of meat products.

Frigorifico Concepcion S.A. is a meat processing company in Paraguay that is involved throughout the beef supply chain, from production to processing, distribution and exporting. Though primarily dealing in beef, the company also processes cattle for leather and biodiesel. It was among the top five exporters of beef from Latin America and is one of the largest exporters of beef in Paraguay and Brazil. Frigorifico Concepcion also owns three ranches totalling 40,000 heads of cattle and also has a monthly slaughter capacity of 40,000 heads of cattle as of 2016.

Ameropa Ltd. is an agri-business based in Switzerland trading in grains, oilseeds and fertilisers. The company currently operates in 31 countries globally.   Ameropa Ltd. is selected as a powerbroker for palm oil and is also assessed for its exposure to soy.

Allanasons Pvt Ltd. is the largest exporter of agro commodities and processed food products in India. The company operates in more than 85 countries, offering a range of products including meat, fish, oilseeds, poultry feed supplements and finished leather products.

Allanasons Pvt Ltd. is large trader of agro commodities and processed food products in India. The company operates in more than 85 countries, offering a range of products including meat, fish, oilseeds, poultry feed supplements and finished leather products.  Allanasons Pvt Ltd. is selected as a powerbroker for beef and is also assessed for its exposure to palm oil, soy, leather and paper packaging.

Weltra are an Italian logistics company specializing in European and international freight and exports. They are assessed for their exposure to leather due to the large volume they export through their networks.

Mar.Vi.Sped are an Italian logistics company specializing in European and international freight and exports. They are assessed for their exposure to leather due to the large volume they export through their networks.

Kai Bo Food Supermarket is a Hong Kong based food retailer primarily selling various meats alongside typical grocery items such as fruit and vegetables through convenience stores. The company has more than 90 branches throughout Hong Kong, making it a major player in the Hong Kong market.  KAI BO FROZEN MEAT SUPERMARKET is selected as a powerbroker for beef.

X5 Retail Group NV is a Russian food retailer, with retail operations in four different formats and brands: Economy stores under the Pyaterochka brand (4,789 stores); supermarkets under the Perekrestok brand (403 stores); hypermarkets under the Karusel brand (82 stores); convenience stores under a range of different brand names (209 stores); and an online retail channel under the E5.ru brand. The company has its origins in 1995, when the Perekrestok supermarket brand was established. The chain of Pyaterochka stores was launched a few years later in 1999, and in 2006 these two brands merged and adopted the X5 Retail Group NV name.
X5 Retail Group's Pyaterochka economy convenience stores provide over 69% of the group's total revenue in 2014 . The Group has been steadily increasing its marketing of private label products and, through its various retail formats, offers a wide range of products, including dairy products, canned goods and groceries, confectionery and bakery products, and fresh and processed meat, among others.

rows.coname: Irmãos Gonçalves Comercio e Industria Ltda
rows.coprofile: Irmãos Gonçalves Comercio e Industria Ltda is based in Brazil and operates in the meat packaging and slaughter house industry.
